summary: Five targets, all under-reached in the same way: each is a well-built, specific entry sitting one conceptual step away from a sibling or parent that names it in prose but never wired it in frontmatter. None needed a forced link — every proposal below reciprocates a relationship the target's own frontmatter, or the neighbour's own body text, had already half-declared. Two patterns repeated across the room: (1) a general/theory entry (Blocked Not Prompted, ControlNet as Topology, Progressive Staging, Toolkit — Audio Plugins) had the specific/concrete entry mention it, but never linked back — a one-way street each time; (2) BLUELINE's own frontmatter shows a consistent house pattern (spawned → Hand-Drawn 3D Look / Frame Designer / Steer the Generator) that it simply hadn't applied to GenAI Camera yet, despite GenAI Camera declaring emerged-from BLUELINE on its own side. Two entries (Does Personifying an Agent Change What It Does, LDN RTM) read as more developed than their stage label suggests — both have full sections, real definitions, and well past the word-count and link-count a seed or sprout carries. One genuine newcomer-wiring gap surfaced outside the strict walk: LDN RTM's body leans on OBS constantly but never links to it in frontmatter, and OBS is itself a zero-inbound newcomer.

Stage (growing) still fits: the forward vector names live unfinished work (single-command orchestration, finger keypoints, multi-figure scenes).

hop1 sufficed — Steer the Generator and The Flow Field is the Spine each already had a connects-to declared FROM ControlNet as Topology but not back. Stage (growing) fits; the entry's own forward vector still names an open split-decision (in-context conditioning / DiT-FLUX).

walk_results.target: Does Personifying an Agent Change What It Does
walk_results.note: hop1 sufficed — Shopkeeper and Maker are both named explicitly in the entry's own body as its two data points ('first case' / 'the control') but neither links back. See entry_health_flags: stage reads under its actual development.

BLUELINE already applies type:spawned to three sibling capabilities it produced (Hand-Drawn 3D Look, Frame Designer, Steer the Generator) but skipped GenAI Camera, which declares emerged-from BLUELINE on its own side ('born-in-the-rig'). One clean reciprocal fixes it. Existing inbound (Search Before You Build, emerged-from) stays as is.

hop1 sufficed — Progressive Staging (LDN RTM already names it a 'productive contradiction' in Cross-Domain Resonances, but the contradicts wasn't reciprocated) and Toolkit — Audio Plugins (LDN RTM's own label 'future-series-source' has no mirror on the Toolkit side, though the Toolkit's forward_vector already names the RTM series). Separately flagged: LDN RTM's own frontmatter is missing OBS despite the body depending on it throughout — noted under unsung_paths since it's the target's own outbound gap, not a neighbour's.

8 outbound typed links plus rich cross-domain resonance, a fully specified pipeline, and named lost branches — well beyond sprout's '150-400 words, 1-2 typed links.' The two new inbound proposed here push it further past threshold.
